message_preview: I received a scammers email saying they were going to expose my informatio.

I received an extortion email from an unknown individual claiming to have hacked my computer and stolen personal information, photos, and private recordings. The sender threatened to distribute the alleged material to my personal and professional contacts unless I paid $1,500 in Bitcoin within 24 hours.

A scammer is claiming a ransom from me because he says he has access to all my passwords and social media accounts etc as well as my computer keyboard and camera. I do not believe this though. He used my own domain to email me. He wants a ransom paid into his bitcoin account which he provided. I am including it below:

Claims to hold the victim's personal data, ID numbers, bank and card data, and demands 500 EUR in Bitcoin within 48 hours, threatening to sell the data on darknet forums. Mass-mailed template, no real data shown. No payment made.
